description: This file defines the internal class `DirectoryMembershipSnapshot` which handles the representation of directory membership in the Orleans distributed runtime. It includes mechanisms for managing ring ranges for silo members, partitioning, and lookup functions related to sink nodes and rings.

classes.name: DirectoryMembershipSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of the directory membership, including member ring ranges, partitions, and lookup methods within Orleans silo cluster.

classes.name: DirectoryMembershipSnapshot.RangeCollection
classes.description: A read-only list of ring ranges with member and partition information within the DirectoryMembershipSnapshot.

methods.name: DirectoryMembershipSnapshot
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the snapshot based on a given cluster membership snapshot and grain factory, establishing ring boundaries and mappings.

methods.name: GetRange
methods.description: Retrieves the ring range for a specified silo address and partition index.

methods.name: GetMemberRanges
methods.description: Returns the ring ranges associated with a specific silo member.

methods.name: GetMemberRangesByPartition
methods.description: Returns the ring ranges for a specific silo member, by address.

methods.name: TryGetOwner
methods.description: Attempts to find the owner silo and partition for a given grain ID or hash code.
